title: Your account
loginRequired: Log in to see your account.

name.title: Display name
name.label: Name
name.hint: Shows in the header and becomes your nickname in communities you join later.

backup.title: If {provider} becomes unavailable, you can't log in.

discord.title: Discord
discord.notLinked: Link to log in with Discord and use your Discord avatar here.
discord.linked: Linked. You can log in with Discord.
discord.unlinkConfirm: You can no longer log in with Discord, and your avatar is removed from the account. You can link it again later.
discord.needsOther: To unlink Discord, first add an email or link Google.

google.title: Google
google.notLinked: The site only receives the name on your Google account, not the email or photo.
google.linked: Linked. You can log in with your Google account.
google.unlinkConfirm: You can no longer log in with your Google account. You can link it again later.
google.needsOther: To unlink Google, first add an email or link Discord.

password.title: Password
password.newPasswordHint: Changing your password ends your other sessions.
password.removeConfirm: You can no longer log in with a password, and the account still logs in by email. You can create one again later.
password.needsEmail: To create a password, first add an email in the section above.
password.resetDone: Other sessions on the account were ended.

email.title: Email
email.signsIn: You log in with a code or link sent to that email.
email.proofNeeded: To change your email, create a password or link Discord or Google, first confirm it's you.
email.proofSent: We sent a code to {email}. It's valid for 15 minutes. Didn't arrive? Check your spam folder.
email.proofFirst: First confirm it's you, in the email section.
email.none: With it, you can log in with a code or link and create a password.
email.label: Email
email.sent: We sent a code and a link to {email}. They're valid for 1 hour. Didn't arrive? Check your spam folder.
email.removeConfirm: You can no longer log in with this email or get account alerts. To create a password later, you'll need an email again.
email.removeBlocked: To remove the email, first remove the password. The password logs in with this email.
email.removeLastLogin: To remove the email, first link Discord or Google.

emailConfirm.title: Confirm email
emailConfirm.text: Confirm to make this your account's email.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.description: End any you don't recognize. To log out of this one, use Log out in the menu.
sessions.endConfirm: That session's browser will be logged out of the account.
sessions.endOthersConfirm: The other browsers will be logged out of the account, and only this session stays active.
sessions.onlyThis: Your account is open only in this session.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: The account is deleted 7 days after the request. Logging in again before then cancels the deletion.
deletion.consequences: On that date, you leave communities and tournaments (in ongoing ones, your pending matches become walkovers). In tournaments you played, your name becomes “Deleted account”.
deletion.owner: Before deleting your account, transfer ownership or delete each community you own:
deletion.confirm: Schedule your account for deletion? You'll be logged out of all devices now.
deletion.cancelled: You logged in again, and the account deletion was cancelled.
